My baby, my 宝宝, Zhan Xiao Chun,

Happy 20th birthday!

Do you remember the university canteen? That's where I saw you for the first time. I didn't know then that the girl eating so happily would become the most important person in my life. (And yes, you still eat more than me.)

Since then we've made so many memories: the sea at Dameisha, flying over the water on the jet ski, falling and laughing on the ice, and every meal we shared, always extra spicy for you.

Now I'm in Pakistan and you're in China, and I miss you every single day. But every time I look at our photos I smile, because I know what we have is real.

Today you turn 20. I wish you endless happiness, lots of delicious spicy food, every badminton match won, and everything your heart wants. I promise I will do my best to be right next to you for your next birthday.

I love you, baby. Today, tomorrow and forever.

Your Moti,
Arhum (Anren)

我的宝宝：

二十岁生日快乐！

还记得大学食堂吗？那是我第一次见到你。那时候我不知道，那个吃饭吃得那么开心的女孩，会成为我生命中最重要的人。（对，你现在还是比我吃得多。）

后来我们一起留下了好多回忆：大梅沙的海，一起骑摩托艇在海上飞，在冰场上摔倒又一起大笑，还有一起吃过的每一顿饭，你的那份永远要加辣。

现在我在巴基斯坦，你在中国，我每天都好想你。可是每次看到我们的照片，我都会笑，因为我知道我们的感情是真的。

今天你二十岁了。愿你每天都开开心心，吃到好多好吃的辣菜，打羽毛球每场都赢，所有的愿望都实现。我答应你，下一个生日我会尽全力陪在你身边。

宝宝，我爱你。今天、明天、永远。

你的 Moti
Arhum（Anren）
